introduced_errors: [Reversed Sequence] Order Fulfillment Starts *before* Payment is received on "No" path (should be after successful payment).
[Swapped Branch Outcomes] Fulfillment starts if payment is *not* received.
[Contradictory Edge Label]  Delivery failure loops back to payment, not reshipment or problem handling.
[Wrong Causal Direction]  Order Confirmation is sent *before* the payment is verified.
[Illogical Loop] Delivery failure loops back to payment request (implies another payment attempt, but no mechanism to retry shipping).
[Skipped critical step] After unsuccessful delivery, no attempt to understand the cause of the failure, no attempt to correct the shipping address, etc.
[Wrong Merge of Parallel Paths] Order Confirmation merges back into order FUlfillment
[Illogical Loop] `Notify User of Delay` (after stock check) leads back to `User Submits Order` – User should only need to submit once.
[Reversed Sequence] `Update Inventory Count` occurs *before* `Order Confirmed`, so the order status is confirmed after inventory is adjusted. It should be before.
[Wrong Merge of Parallel Paths] `Reorder Stock` merges into `Order Confirmed`. Reordering should not influence if the *current* order is confirmed; they are independent.
[Swapped Branch Outcomes] If Inventory Count is *not* below Threshold, `Reorder Stock` is triggered. Expected the other way around.
[Skipped Critical Step] No step to notify the user that their order has been shipped
[Swapped Branch Outcomes] 'No' from Payment Received loops back to User Issues Payment (should loop on 'Yes' until received).
[Reversed Sequence] Fulfill Order shown *before* Shipping Label Created (should be after).
[Illogical Loop] Archive Order Data loops back to Payment Received (should be end of flow).
[Skipped Critical Step] No Inventory Check step before Fulfill Order.
[Wrong Merge of Parallel Paths] 'No' from Survey Received leads to Initiate Refund Process, but then merges *back* into Fulfill Order. Refund should be separate.
[Wrong Causal Direction] Analyzing survey results *before* archiving order data. Archive logically preceded the analysis.
[Reversed sequence] "Shipping Label Printed?" check comes after packaging (should be before).
[Swapped branch outcomes] "Shipping Label Printed?" No outcome jumps to `Order Shipped` (should loop back to printing label).
[Illogical loop] "Shipping Label Printed?" Yes outcome loops back to packaging (should continue to shipping if label printed).
[Skipped critical step] No step between `Package Items for Shipping` and `Determine Shipping Method`.
[Wrong merge of parallel paths] `Cancel Order Process` merges into `Close Order` (should not).
[Wrong causal direction] User can confirm delivery only to be sent back to a `Notify User of Shipment` step.
[Reversed Sequence] User notified of delay *before* payment is refunded (Refund should precede notification).
[Swapped Branch Outcomes] 'No' on Inventory Available should cancel the Order and Refund
[Illogical Loop] Order Delivered loops back to User Submits Order.
[Wrong Causal Direction] Cancel Order after Prepare Shipment.
[Wrong Merge of Parallel Paths] No log error before shipping confirmation
[Skipped Critical Step] Refund payment not leading to order closed.
[Wrong Merge of Parallel Paths] Refund payment goes to log error and then to send shipping confirmation.
